The '''Trindello system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trindello/Legends|Trindello]].
